parsed.summary: The patch introduces a conditional encoding mechanism based on the DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM setting, which seems to address the issue of session data decoding during the transition to Django 3.1. However, the approach appears to be a bit hacky and may introduce compatibility issues.

issues.description: The patch uses a legacy encoding format when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1', which is a hacky approach and may introduce compatibility issues with other parts of the codebase.
